name: wide_diverse_v2
reference_run: Preserved wide_diverse_v1 is the 50M/d1 baseline. New runs retain its seed, optimizer settings, minibatch size, sampler objective, features and validation-selection rule. All new networks initialize from scratch.
scope: Second local observational expansion and single-seed 2x2 size/data comparison. d1 is original plus first expansion; d2 adds disjoint second-expansion windows. Same four conservative source cohorts; no independent incident-count claim. Validation and test are reused, not a new blind test.
